title: Volley Progress Channel Message
description: Fire-and-forget progress event published on the progress channel. See spec section 4. The type stays an open string; the hook activity types (heartbeat, idle, awaiting_input, resumed, activity; steering_applied is reserved, the reference hooks never publish it) and steering_acked are documented in spec section 4.3.

type.description: Free-form progress event tag (e.g. tests-green, mvn-verify-done, diff-ready). Documented types: heartbeat, idle, awaiting_input, resumed, activity (hook activity, payload.source = harness-hook; steering_applied is reserved and never published by the reference hooks) and steering_acked (correlation_id names the acknowledged mailbox message).

progress.description: Advisory percent-complete in [0, 100]; receivers tolerate null or non-numeric values (spec section 4.3).

msg.description: Short human-readable narration of what the agent is doing now.

seq.description: Hook activity: per-agent monotonic sequence number.

source.description: Hook activity: harness-hook when published by a harness hook rather than the model.

hook_event.description: Hook activity: the harness hook event that fired (e.g. Stop, Notification, PostToolUse).

text.description: Hook activity: last assistant line or notification text.

notification_type.description: Hook activity: harness notification type (e.g. agent_needs_input).

question.description: awaiting_input: what the agent is asking. The harness hooks send the question paragraph whole (an excerpt of its end beyond 8192 characters); a supervisor's wave-state coordinator.question carries its first one or two lines.

class.description: awaiting_input: why the harness is waiting when it is not a question, e.g. credit (a provider usage limit; the harness resumes on its own when it resets).

background_wait.description: idle / awaiting_input: true when the session ended its turn without a question while a background task it started is still running; it waits on that task's events, not on a human (spec section 4.3). Never set on a permission_prompt.

completed.description: idle: true when the harness reported the agent's task completed (notification agent_completed).

session_url.description: awaiting_input: link to the waiting session, when known.

workspace.description: awaiting_input: terminal workspace hosting the session, when known.

tool_calls.description: activity / idle: the session's tool calls so far (spec section 4.3).
